original_prompt: Create an Ansible playbook that installs the OpenTelemetry Collector (binary or yum/apt repository), configures it to receive OTLP on port 4317 and export to a remote endpoint, and starts it as a systemd service.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: Ansible playbook (YAML)

Task: Create an Ansible playbook that installs the OpenTelemetry Collector (binary or yum/apt repository), configures it to receive OTLP on port 4317 and export to a remote endpoint, and starts it as a systemd service.

Output only the Ansible playbook (YAML) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
```yaml
---
- name: Install and configure OpenTelemetry Collector
  hosts: all
  become: true
  vars:
    otelcol_version: "0.88.0"
    otelcol_arch: "linux_amd64"
    remote_endpoint: "otel-collector.example.com:4317"
    config_path: "/etc/otelcol/config.yaml"
  tasks:
    - name: Ensure required packages are installed
      ansible.builtin.package:
        name:
          - curl
          - tar
        state: present

    - name: Download OpenTelemetry Collector binary
      ansible.builtin.get_url:
        url: "https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector-releases/releases/download/v{{ otelcol_version }}/otelcol-contrib_{{ otelcol_version }}_{{ otelcol_arch }}.tar.gz"
        dest: "/tmp/otelcol-contrib.tar.gz"
        mode: "0644"
        checksum: "sha256:https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector-releases/releases/download/v{{ otelcol_version }}/otelcol-contrib_{{ otelcol_version }}_{{ otelcol_arch }}.tar.gz.sha256sum"

    - name: Extract OpenTelemetry Collector binary
      ansible.builtin.unarchive:
        src: "/tmp/otelcol-contrib.tar.gz"
        dest: "/usr/local/bin"
        remote_src: true
        creates: "/usr/local/bin/otelcol-contrib"

    - name: Set executable permissions on binary
      ansible.builtin.file:
        path: "/usr/local/bin/otelcol-contrib"
        mode: "0755"
        owner: root
        group: root

    - name: Create otelcol system group
      ansible.builtin.group:
        name: otelcol
        system: true

    - name: Create otelcol system user
      ansible.builtin.user:
        name: otelcol
        system: true
        group: otelcol
        shell: /sbin/nologin
        create_home: false

    - name: Create configuration directory
      ansible.builtin.file:
        path: "/etc/otelcol"
        state: directory
        owner: root
        group: otelcol
        mode: "0750"

    - name: Deploy OpenTelemetry Collector configuration
      ansible.builtin.template:
        src: "otelcol-config.yaml.j2"
        dest: "{{ config_path }}"
        owner: root
        group: otelcol
        mode: "0640"
      notify: Restart otelcol

    - name: Create systemd service unit file
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        dest: "/etc/systemd/system/otelcol.service"
        owner: root
        group: root
        mode: "0644"
        content: |
          [Unit]
          Description=OpenTelemetry Collector
          After=network.target

          [Service]
          Type=simple
          User=otelcol
          Group=otelcol
          ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/otelcol-contrib --config={{ config_path }}
          Restart=always
          RestartSec=5
          LimitNOFILE=65536
          NoNewPrivileges=true
          ProtectSystem=strict
          ProtectHome=true
          PrivateTmp=true

          [Install]
          WantedBy=multi-user.target
      notify: Reload systemd

    - name: Enable and start otelcol service
      ansible.builtin.systemd:
        name: otelcol
        state: started
        enabled: true
        daemon_reload: true

  handlers:
    - name: Reload systemd
      ansible.builtin.systemd:
        daemon_reload: true

    - name: Restart otelcol
      ansible.builtin.systemd:
        name: otelcol
        state: restarted
```
